propositions: MCP unlink_tickets lacks an optional relation parameter in both its registered FastMCP signature and rebar.unlink delegate call, preventing relation-specific edge removal.
When unlink_tickets is called with a specific relation (e.g. blocks), it removes the newest edge instead of the requested edge because the relation value is not forwarded.
The public library, CLI, and documentation already support relation-scoped unlink; MCP diverges from the signed write-parameter parity requirement.
Adding the relation parameter to the MCP callable signature alone does not fix the bug; the value must also be forwarded to rebar.unlink to take effect.
Omitting the relation parameter should preserve existing pair-scoped most-recent fallback behavior for backward compatibility.
